summary: A framework document that describes and motivates Source Address Validation Improvement (SAVI) methods, which stop nodes on the same IP link from spoofing each other's addresses. It complements ingress filtering with finer-grained checks; specific methods are defined elsewhere.

eli5.summary: In a classroom, nobody should pretend to be another kid when passing notes. SAVI checks the sender's name on every note.

questions: how to prevent ip source address spoofing on a link
